sources.title: The Ultimate Stable Diffusion LoRA Guide (Downloading, Usage, Training)
sources.snippet: You can use LoRAs with any Stable Diffusion model, so long as the model and LoRA are both part of the same series: LoRAs trained from SD v1.x will only work with models trained from SD v1.x LoRAs trained from SD v2.x will only work with models trained from SD v2.x LoRAs trained from SDXL will only work with models trained from SDXL Generally, realistic LoRAs work better with realistic models ...
